examples.english: She felt apprehensive about meeting her boyfriend's parents for the first time.
examples.persian: او برای اولین ملاقات با والدین دوست‌پسرش نگران و مضطرب بود.

examples.english: Investors grew apprehensive as the central bank hinted at further rate hikes.
examples.persian: با اشاره بانک مرکزی به افزایش بیشتر نرخ بهره، سرمایه‌گذاران نگران شدند.

examples.english: He was apprehensive about flying after the turbulence on his last trip.
examples.persian: او پس از تلاطم هوایی سفر قبلی‌اش، نسبت به پرواز مضطرب بود.

miniContext: Students often feel apprehensive the night before a major exam, even when they know the material well. An apprehensive patient may ask the surgeon the same question several times, seeking reassurance rather than new information. Being apprehensive about change is natural, but it rarely stops the change from happening anyway.

examples.english: The young lawyer was remarkably articulate, laying out her argument without a single stumble.
examples.persian: وکیل جوان به‌طرز شگفت‌انگیزی شیوا و روشن بود و استدلال خود را بدون کوچک‌ترین لغزشی بیان کرد.

examples.english: He gave an articulate defense of the policy despite the hostile questions.
examples.persian: او با وجود پرسش‌های خصمانه، دفاعی شیوا و روشن از این سیاست ارائه داد.

examples.english: She is articulate enough to explain quantum physics to a room of ten-year-olds.
examples.persian: او آنقدر شیوا و روان صحبت می‌کند که می‌تواند فیزیک کوانتوم را برای گروهی از کودکان ده‌ساله توضیح دهد.

miniContext: Debate coaches spend hours teaching students to be articulate under pressure, since a brilliant argument means little if it comes out garbled. An articulate witness can sway a jury almost as much as the facts themselves. Being articulate isn't about using big words; it's about making a complicated idea sound simple.

examples.english: The nurse was known throughout the ward for her compassionate bedside manner.
examples.persian: این پرستار در سراسر بخش به خاطر رفتار دلسوزانه‌اش در کنار بیماران شناخته می‌شد.

examples.english: A compassionate response to the refugees' arrival replaced the town's initial suspicion.
examples.persian: واکنشی دلسوزانه به ورود پناهجویان، جای شک و تردید اولیه شهر را گرفت.

examples.english: He remained compassionate toward the thief, understanding the desperation behind the crime.
examples.persian: او با درک ناامیدی پشت این جرم، نسبت به دزد همچنان دلسوز باقی ماند.

miniContext: Hospice workers need to be especially compassionate, since their patients are often facing the hardest weeks of their lives. A compassionate leader doesn't ignore mistakes, but responds to them with understanding rather than punishment. Religious traditions across the world consistently teach that being compassionate toward strangers is a measure of one's character.

examples.english: The monks lived an austere life, owning nothing beyond a robe and a bowl.
examples.persian: راهبان زندگی ساده و زاهدانه‌ای داشتند و چیزی بیش از یک ردا و یک کاسه مالک نبودند.

examples.english: The new finance minister imposed austere budget cuts across every government department.
examples.persian: وزیر دارایی جدید کاهش‌های بودجه‌ای سخت‌گیرانه‌ای را در تمام بخش‌های دولتی اعمال کرد.

examples.english: Her office was austere, with bare walls and a single wooden desk.
examples.persian: دفتر او ساده و بی‌پیرایه بود، با دیوارهای خالی و یک میز چوبی.

miniContext: Spartan society was famously austere, discouraging luxury and training children from an early age to endure hardship. Governments facing debt crises often adopt austere policies, cutting public spending even when it costs them politically. The cathedral's austere interior, stripped of ornament during the Reformation, stands in sharp contrast to the gilded churches of Rome.

examples.english: She found a diplomatic way to decline the invitation without offending her hosts.
examples.persian: او راهی دیپلماتیک و سنجیده برای رد دعوت بدون رنجاندن میزبانانش پیدا کرد.

examples.english: The ambassador's diplomatic skill helped defuse a tense standoff between the two nations.
examples.persian: مهارت دیپلماتیک سفیر به کاهش تنش میان دو کشور کمک کرد.

examples.english: He gave a diplomatic answer that avoided taking sides in the dispute.
examples.persian: او پاسخی سنجیده و دیپلماتیک داد که از جانبداری در این اختلاف پرهیز می‌کرد.

miniContext: Career diplomats are trained to stay diplomatic even when provoked, since a single careless remark can derail years of negotiation. Being diplomatic at a family dinner sometimes requires the same skill as negotiating a trade treaty. The ambassador's diplomatic phrasing left both delegations believing they had won a small concession.

examples.english: An empathetic listener doesn't rush to offer advice before understanding the problem.
examples.persian: یک شنونده همدل پیش از درک کامل مسئله، شتاب‌زده پیشنهاد نمی‌دهد.

examples.english: The therapist's empathetic response put the grieving family at ease immediately.
examples.persian: پاسخ همدلانه درمانگر، خانواده‌ی داغدار را فوراً آرام کرد.

examples.english: Good teachers tend to be empathetic toward students who are struggling at home.
examples.persian: معلمان خوب معمولاً نسبت به دانش‌آموزانی که در خانه مشکل دارند همدل هستند.

miniContext: Nurses who are naturally empathetic often report higher job satisfaction despite the emotional toll of the work. Being empathetic toward a political opponent doesn't mean agreeing with them; it means trying to understand why they believe what they do. Researchers have found that reading fiction regularly can make people more empathetic toward strangers.

examples.english: The senator delivered an eloquent tribute to the soldiers who had died overseas.
examples.persian: سناتور سخنرانی فصیح و شیوایی در بزرگداشت سربازانی که در خارج از کشور جان باخته بودند ایراد کرد.

examples.english: Her eloquent plea moved even the most skeptical members of the jury.
examples.persian: التماس فصیح او حتی بدگمان‌ترین اعضای هیئت منصفه را متأثر کرد.

examples.english: He was too nervous to be eloquent, but his sincerity came through anyway.
examples.persian: او برای فصیح بودن بیش از حد مضطرب بود، اما صداقتش همچنان آشکار بود.

miniContext: Churchill's wartime speeches remain eloquent enough to be studied in rhetoric classes eighty years later. An eloquent eulogy can turn a funeral into a genuine celebration of a life well lived. Being eloquent under pressure, in a courtroom or on a stage, is a skill that takes most speakers years of practice to develop.

examples.english: The CEO was forthright about the company's losses during the shareholder meeting.
examples.persian: مدیرعامل در جلسه سهامداران درباره زیان‌های شرکت صریح و رک بود.

examples.english: She gave a forthright assessment of her own mistakes without making excuses.
examples.persian: او بدون بهانه‌تراشی، ارزیابی صریحی از اشتباهات خودش ارائه داد.

examples.english: His forthright manner sometimes came across as blunt, but colleagues trusted him for it.
examples.persian: رفتار صریح و رک او گاهی خشک به نظر می‌رسید، اما همکاران به همین دلیل به او اعتماد داشتند.

miniContext: Reporters appreciate a forthright official far more than one who hides behind vague, evasive language. Being forthright about bad news early usually costs a company less trust than being caught concealing it later. Her forthright testimony, delivered without a single rehearsed line, convinced the committee she had nothing to hide.

examples.english: The benevolent landlord forgave three months of rent after the factory closed.
examples.persian: صاحبخانه‌ی خیرخواه پس از تعطیلی کارخانه، سه ماه اجاره را بخشید.

examples.english: Villagers still speak of the benevolent king who built wells across the countryside.
examples.persian: روستاییان هنوز از آن پادشاه خیرخواه که در سراسر روستاها چاه حفر کرد یاد می‌کنند.

examples.english: The foundation's benevolent mission is to fund schools in regions with no public education.
examples.persian: هدف خیرخواهانه این بنیاد تأمین مالی مدارس در مناطقی است که آموزش عمومی ندارند.

miniContext: Historians debate whether any ruler can truly be called benevolent, since even generous policies often serve the ruler's own interests. A benevolent employer invests in staff training even when a cheaper, short-term alternative exists. Folk tales across cultures feature a benevolent stranger who helps the hero at exactly the right moment.

examples.english: The losing candidate gave a gracious speech, congratulating her opponent on a hard-fought race.
examples.persian: نامزد بازنده سخنرانی بزرگوارانه‌ای ایراد کرد و رقیبش را به خاطر رقابتی سخت تبریک گفت.

examples.english: Our hosts were gracious enough to let us stay an extra night when our flight was cancelled.
examples.persian: میزبانان ما آن‌قدر مهربان و بزرگوار بودند که اجازه دادند شب دیگری هم بمانیم وقتی پرواز ما لغو شد.

examples.english: He remained gracious in defeat, shaking every player's hand before leaving the court.
examples.persian: او در شکست هم بزرگوارانه رفتار کرد و پیش از ترک زمین با هر بازیکن دست داد.

miniContext: Olympic athletes are expected to be gracious in both victory and defeat, shaking hands and praising their rivals regardless of the outcome. A gracious host makes even an uninvited guest feel welcome at the table. Being gracious after an insult, rather than retaliating, often disarms the person who insulted you far more effectively than anger would.

examples.english: Despite winning three championships, she remained humble about her own abilities.
examples.persian: او با وجود کسب سه قهرمانی، همچنان نسبت به توانایی‌های خودش فروتن ماند.

examples.english: He grew up in a humble household where nothing was ever wasted.
examples.persian: او در خانه‌ای فروتنانه و بی‌تجمل بزرگ شد که در آن هیچ چیز هدر نمی‌رفت.

examples.english: The scientist was humble enough to admit her first theory had been wrong.
examples.persian: این دانشمند آن‌قدر فروتن بود که پذیرفت نظریه اولش اشتباه بوده است.

miniContext: Great leaders are often remembered as humble despite their power, choosing to credit their teams rather than themselves. Coming from a humble background doesn't guarantee success, but it often instills a work ethic that wealth rarely teaches. Being humble enough to ask for help is, paradoxically, one of the hardest skills for high achievers to learn.

examples.english: Judges are expected to remain impartial, even in cases that touch them personally.
examples.persian: از قضات انتظار می‌رود حتی در پرونده‌هایی که به آن‌ها شخصاً مربوط می‌شود، بی‌طرف بمانند.

examples.english: The newspaper claims to offer impartial coverage of every candidate in the election.
examples.persian: این روزنامه مدعی است پوشش بی‌طرفانه‌ای از تمام نامزدهای انتخابات ارائه می‌دهد.

examples.english: An impartial referee is essential if both teams are to trust the result.
examples.persian: برای اینکه هر دو تیم به نتیجه اعتماد کنند، وجود داوری بی‌طرف ضروری است.

miniContext: International courts rely on impartial judges from neutral countries to hear disputes between rival nations. Staying impartial becomes especially difficult when a case involves a close friend or relative. Readers increasingly question whether any news outlet can truly be impartial when its owners have obvious political interests.

examples.english: After years of relying on her parents, she finally felt financially independent.
examples.persian: او پس از سال‌ها وابستگی به والدینش، سرانجام از نظر مالی احساس استقلال کرد.

examples.english: The central bank is designed to remain independent of political pressure.
examples.persian: بانک مرکزی به گونه‌ای طراحی شده که از فشارهای سیاسی مستقل بماند.

examples.english: An independent investigation cleared the company of any wrongdoing.
examples.persian: یک بازرسی مستقل شرکت را از هرگونه تخلف تبرئه کرد.

miniContext: Many former colonies spent decades fighting to become independent nations, only to face new economic pressures afterward. Teenagers often push for independence long before they're prepared to be fully independent, financially or otherwise. An independent panel of scientists, with no ties to the manufacturer, was brought in to review the drug's safety data.

examples.english: The professor's insightful comments helped the student see a flaw in her own argument.
examples.persian: اظهارنظرهای بصیرت‌آمیز استاد به دانشجو کمک کرد تا نقصی در استدلال خودش ببیند.

examples.english: Critics praised the documentary for its insightful look at the refugee crisis.
examples.persian: منتقدان این مستند را به خاطر نگاه بصیرت‌آمیزش به بحران پناهجویان ستودند.

examples.english: She asked an insightful question that nobody else in the room had considered.
examples.persian: او سوالی بصیرت‌آمیز پرسید که هیچ‌کس دیگری در اتاق به آن فکر نکرده بود.

miniContext: The best biographies are insightful not because they list every fact, but because they explain why their subject behaved as they did. An insightful mentor can spot a weakness in a young employee's reasoning before it becomes a costly mistake. Her insightful review of the failed merger became required reading for a generation of business students.

examples.english: The restorer kept meticulous records of every pigment used on the painting.
examples.persian: بازسازی‌گر سوابق بسیار دقیقی از هر رنگدانه‌ی استفاده‌شده روی تابلو نگه داشت.

examples.english: Her meticulous attention to detail caught an error the entire editorial team had missed.
examples.persian: دقت بسیار زیاد او به جزئیات، خطایی را کشف کرد که کل تیم ویراستاری از قلم انداخته بود.

examples.english: He is meticulous about labeling every wire before disconnecting anything.
examples.persian: او پیش از قطع هر سیمی، بسیار دقیق برچسب‌گذاری می‌کند.

miniContext: Forensic accountants must be meticulous, since a single overlooked transaction can hide years of fraud. Being meticulous in the lab is non-negotiable when a tiny contamination can ruin months of research. The chef's meticulous plating turned an ordinary dish into something that looked almost too precise to eat.

examples.english: The actor gave a candid interview about his struggles with addiction.
examples.persian: این بازیگر مصاحبه‌ای صریح و صادقانه درباره مبارزه‌اش با اعتیاد انجام داد.

examples.english: She was refreshingly candid about the startup's failures, not just its successes.
examples.persian: او به‌طرز تحسین‌برانگیزی درباره شکست‌های استارتاپ، نه فقط موفقیت‌هایش، صادق و صریح بود.

examples.english: He asked for a candid opinion, not the polite answer everyone else had given.
examples.persian: او نظر صریح و صادقانه خواست، نه پاسخ مودبانه‌ای که دیگران داده بودند.

miniContext: Memoirs feel more honest when the author is candid about personal failures rather than only celebrating achievements. A candid conversation with a doctor, including uncomfortable questions, usually leads to better treatment decisions. Being candid in a performance review can feel harsh in the moment, but employees generally prefer it to vague, empty praise.

examples.english: The detective's perceptive eye caught a detail every other investigator had missed.
examples.persian: چشم تیزبین کارآگاه جزئیاتی را دید که همه بازپرسان دیگر از قلم انداخته بودند.

examples.english: She made a perceptive remark about the tension simmering beneath the family's politeness.
examples.persian: او نظر تیزبینانه‌ای درباره تنشی که زیر لایه ادب خانواده پنهان بود مطرح کرد.

examples.english: A perceptive reader will notice the clue hidden in the novel's very first page.
examples.persian: خواننده‌ی تیزبین سرنخی را که در همان صفحه اول رمان پنهان شده متوجه می‌شود.

miniContext: Good therapists are perceptive enough to notice what a client avoids saying, not just what they say outright. Being perceptive about market shifts gave the small firm a six-month head start over its larger competitors. The child's perceptive question, about why the king never visited the poor, left the teacher without a simple answer.

examples.english: The city took a proactive approach to flooding by rebuilding levees years before the storm hit.
examples.persian: شهر با بازسازی سدهای محافظ سال‌ها پیش از وقوع طوفان، رویکردی پیش‌قدمانه در برابر سیل اتخاذ کرد.

examples.english: Rather than wait for complaints, the manager was proactive about fixing the software bug.
examples.persian: مدیر به‌جای منتظر ماندن برای شکایت‌ها، پیش‌قدم شد و اشکال نرم‌افزاری را برطرف کرد.

examples.english: Doctors now encourage patients to be proactive about scheduling regular screenings.
examples.persian: پزشکان اکنون بیماران را تشویق می‌کنند که برای برنامه‌ریزی آزمایش‌های منظم پیش‌قدم باشند.

miniContext: Companies that stay proactive about cybersecurity spend far less, on average, than those that only react after a breach. Being proactive about a chronic illness, rather than waiting for a crisis, often adds years to a patient's life. The coach's proactive substitutions late in the match caught the opposing team completely off guard.

examples.english: The audience was receptive to the comedian's edgier material once he had their trust.
examples.persian: تماشاگران پس از آنکه اعتمادشان را جلب کرد، نسبت به مطالب تندتر این کمدین پذیرا شدند.

examples.english: Investors seemed receptive to the pitch, asking detailed follow-up questions.
examples.persian: سرمایه‌گذاران نسبت به این طرح پذیرا به نظر می‌رسیدند و سوالات تفصیلی پرسیدند.

examples.english: Teenagers are more receptive to advice from peers than from parents.
examples.persian: نوجوانان نسبت به نصیحت همسالان، بیشتر از والدین پذیرا هستند.

miniContext: Negotiators try to gauge how receptive the other side is before revealing their actual bottom line. A receptive audience can transform a mediocre speech into a memorable one simply through their energy and attention. Plants are more receptive to pruning in early spring, before new growth has fully set.

examples.english: Visitors are expected to remain respectful of local customs when touring the temple.
examples.persian: از بازدیدکنندگان انتظار می‌رود هنگام بازدید از معبد نسبت به رسوم محلی محترمانه رفتار کنند.

examples.english: The debate stayed respectful even though the two candidates disagreed on almost everything.
examples.persian: مناظره با وجود اینکه دو نامزد تقریباً در همه چیز اختلاف داشتند، محترمانه باقی ماند.

examples.english: She asked a respectful but pointed question about the mayor's spending record.
examples.persian: او سوالی محترمانه اما دقیق درباره سابقه هزینه‌کرد شهردار پرسید.

miniContext: Funerals across cultures share one rule above all others: guests are expected to remain respectful, whatever their private opinion of the deceased. A respectful disagreement, unlike an argument, leaves both sides willing to keep talking afterward. Being respectful toward an opponent in defeat says more about a person's character than winning gracefully ever could.

examples.english: Stranded without a map, the hikers proved resourceful, navigating by the stars alone.
examples.persian: کوهنوردانی که بدون نقشه گیر افتاده بودند، با تدبیر عمل کردند و تنها با ستاره‌ها مسیر یافتند.

examples.english: The resourceful intern found a free dataset that saved the team weeks of work.
examples.persian: کارآموز با تدبیر، مجموعه‌داده‌ای رایگان پیدا کرد که هفته‌ها کار تیم را کاهش داد.

examples.english: Survivors of the shipwreck were resourceful enough to build a raft from the wreckage.
examples.persian: بازماندگان کشتی غرق‌شده آن‌قدر با تدبیر بودند که از بقایای کشتی یک قایق ساختند.

miniContext: Entrepreneurs in resource-poor regions often become remarkably resourceful, building businesses with a fraction of the capital available elsewhere. Being resourceful under a deadline, rather than simply working harder, is what separates efficient teams from exhausted ones. The novel's resourceful heroine escapes captivity using nothing but a hairpin and a knowledge of the guards' schedule.

examples.english: It was sensible to postpone the hike once the forecast predicted lightning.
examples.persian: با توجه به پیش‌بینی رعد و برق، به تعویق انداختن پیاده‌روی کاری عاقلانه بود.

examples.english: She gave sensible advice about budgeting that he wished he'd heard years earlier.
examples.persian: او توصیه‌ای عاقلانه و منطقی درباره بودجه‌بندی داد که ای کاش سال‌ها زودتر شنیده بود.

examples.english: Wearing a helmet on a construction site is simply sensible, not optional.
examples.persian: پوشیدن کلاه ایمنی در محل ساخت‌وساز صرفاً کاری عاقلانه است، نه اختیاری.

miniContext: Financial advisors generally recommend a sensible mix of savings and investment rather than chasing speculative trends. A sensible compromise, even an imperfect one, often outlasts a brilliant plan nobody is willing to follow. Being sensible under pressure, when everyone else is panicking, is a trait that calm leaders share.

examples.english: His sincere apology, delivered without excuses, finally repaired their friendship.
examples.persian: عذرخواهی صمیمانه و صادقانه او، بدون هیچ بهانه‌ای، سرانجام دوستی‌شان را ترمیم کرد.

examples.english: She offered sincere condolences to the family after the funeral service.
examples.persian: او پس از مراسم تشییع، تسلیت صمیمانه‌ای به خانواده ابراز کرد.

examples.english: A sincere compliment means more than a dozen empty ones.
examples.persian: یک تعریف صادقانه بیشتر از ده‌ها تعریف بی‌روح ارزش دارد.

miniContext: Readers can usually tell the difference between a sincere thank-you note and one written out of obligation. Being sincere during a eulogy, rather than reciting polished clichés, is what makes mourners actually remember the words. His sincere interest in her research, rather than polite small talk, is what first made her trust him.

examples.english: The lab developed a sophisticated algorithm capable of detecting tumors earlier than any previous method.
examples.persian: این آزمایشگاه الگوریتمی پیشرفته ساخت که قادر است تومورها را زودتر از هر روش قبلی تشخیص دهد.

examples.english: Her palate had grown sophisticated enough to distinguish the subtlest regional variations in olive oil.
examples.persian: ذائقه او آن‌قدر پخته و پیشرفته شده بود که می‌توانست ظریف‌ترین تفاوت‌های منطقه‌ای روغن زیتون را تشخیص دهد.

examples.english: The heist required sophisticated planning, including blueprints stolen months in advance.
examples.persian: این سرقت به برنامه‌ریزی پیشرفته‌ای نیاز داشت، از جمله نقشه‌هایی که ماه‌ها پیش دزدیده شده بودند.

miniContext: Modern missile defense systems rely on sophisticated radar capable of tracking dozens of objects simultaneously. A sophisticated reader notices an author's subtle choices of word and rhythm, not just the plot. What looks like a sophisticated scam to an outsider is often, to the con artist, a well-rehearsed and simple routine.

examples.english: She found a tactful way to tell her friend that the business idea wouldn't work.
examples.persian: او راهی با ملاحظه برای گفتن این موضوع به دوستش پیدا کرد که ایده‌ی تجاری‌اش جواب نخواهد داد.

examples.english: The doctor was tactful when explaining the diagnosis to the frightened patient.
examples.persian: پزشک هنگام توضیح تشخیص به بیمار ترسیده، با ملاحظه رفتار کرد.

examples.english: His tactful handling of the layoffs earned him respect even from those who lost their jobs.
examples.persian: برخورد با ملاحظه او در هنگام تعدیل نیرو، حتی احترام کسانی را که شغل خود را از دست دادند نیز به همراه داشت.

miniContext: Human resources staff are trained to be tactful when delivering difficult news, balancing honesty with compassion. Being tactful doesn't mean avoiding the truth; it means choosing the right moment and words to deliver it. A tactful host steers the conversation away from politics the moment things start getting heated at the table.

examples.english: He gave a thoughtful answer that considered perspectives most people would overlook.
examples.persian: او پاسخی سنجیده و با ملاحظه داد که دیدگاه‌هایی را در نظر می‌گرفت که بیشتر مردم از آن غافل می‌شوند.

examples.english: The thoughtful gift showed she had actually remembered their conversation from months earlier.
examples.persian: آن هدیه با ملاحظه نشان می‌داد که او واقعاً گفتگویشان را از ماه‌ها پیش به خاطر داشته است.

examples.english: Her thoughtful feedback on the manuscript helped the author rewrite the entire second act.
examples.persian: بازخورد سنجیده او درباره دست‌نوشته، به نویسنده کمک کرد تا کل پرده دوم را بازنویسی کند.

miniContext: A thoughtful leader asks questions before issuing orders, trying to understand a problem fully before acting on it. Being thoughtful about a friend's grief sometimes means saying nothing at all, just staying present. The professor's thoughtful marginal notes meant more to the student than the grade itself.

examples.english: The teacher remained tolerant of the students' mistakes as they learned a difficult new concept.
examples.persian: معلم نسبت به اشتباهات دانش‌آموزان در یادگیری این مفهوم دشوار جدید، بردبار باقی ماند.

examples.english: A tolerant society allows minority opinions to be expressed without fear of punishment.
examples.persian: یک جامعه بردبار اجازه می‌دهد عقاید اقلیت بدون ترس از مجازات بیان شوند.

examples.english: Over the years, her stomach grew more tolerant of spicy food.
examples.persian: در طول سال‌ها، معده او نسبت به غذای تند بردبارتر شد.

miniContext: Historians note that empires which stayed tolerant of religious minorities often lasted longer than those that tried to enforce strict uniformity. Being tolerant of a colleague's working style, even when it differs from your own, usually makes a team function better. Certain plant species are remarkably tolerant of drought, surviving months without a drop of rain.

examples.english: Olive oil is a versatile ingredient, equally at home in a dressing or a marinade.
examples.persian: روغن زیتون ماده‌ای چندکاره است که هم در سس سالاد و هم در مارینیت به‌خوبی جا می‌افتد.

examples.english: The new midfielder is versatile enough to play in four different positions.
examples.persian: هافبک جدید به‌قدری انعطاف‌پذیر است که می‌تواند در چهار پست مختلف بازی کند.

examples.english: A versatile actor can move convincingly between comedy and tragedy within the same film.
examples.persian: یک بازیگر چندکاره می‌تواند در یک فیلم به‌طرز باورپذیری میان کمدی و تراژدی حرکت کند.

miniContext: Carpenters prize a versatile tool that can handle several tasks without constant swapping between equipment. Being versatile at work, able to step into different roles when needed, has become increasingly valuable as companies shrink their teams. Bamboo is a remarkably versatile material, used for everything from scaffolding to musical instruments.

examples.english: Investors remained wary of the stock after two consecutive quarters of disappointing earnings.
examples.persian: سرمایه‌گذاران پس از دو فصل متوالی درآمد ناامیدکننده، همچنان نسبت به این سهم محتاط بودند.

examples.english: The deer stayed wary, lifting its head at the faintest sound in the brush.
examples.persian: آهو محتاط و هوشیار ماند و با کوچک‌ترین صدایی در بیشه‌زار سرش را بالا می‌آورد.

examples.english: She grew wary of strangers offering deals that sounded too good to be true.
examples.persian: او نسبت به غریبه‌هایی که پیشنهادهایی خیلی‌خوب‌برای‌باور‌کردن می‌دادند محتاط شد.

miniContext: After the scandal, voters grew wary of any politician making sweeping promises without a clear plan. Being wary in a negotiation doesn't mean being hostile; it means verifying claims before accepting them. Wild animals that lose their natural wariness around humans often end up in dangerous situations near roads and towns.

examples.english: She was willing to relocate across the country for the right job opportunity.
examples.persian: او برای فرصت شغلی مناسب، حاضر و مایل بود به سراسر کشور نقل‌مکان کند.

examples.english: Few volunteers were willing to work the overnight shift during the storm.
examples.persian: تعداد کمی از داوطلبان مایل بودند شیفت شبانه را در طول طوفان کار کنند.

examples.english: He remained willing to compromise even after the talks nearly collapsed twice.
examples.persian: او حتی پس از دو بار نزدیک شدن مذاکرات به شکست، همچنان مایل به مصالحه باقی ماند.

miniContext: Employers increasingly look for candidates willing to learn new skills rather than those who already know everything the job requires. Being willing to apologize first, even when you're not entirely at fault, often repairs a relationship faster than waiting for the other person to go first. Only a handful of countries were willing to accept refugees during the first wave of the crisis.
